mapper.select: SELECT S.id, S.name, S.professor_id, S.dept_id, S.type, S.sub_year as subYear, S.semester, S.sub_day as subDay, S.grades, CASE WHEN SY.status = 'TEMP' THEN 0 WHEN SY.subject_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS syllabus FROM pu_subject S LEFT JOIN pu_syllabus SY ON S.id = SY.subject_id WHERE professor_id = #{professorId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pu_syllabus SET overview = #{overview}, objective = #{objective}, textbook = #{textbook}, status = #{status}, pdf_path = #{pdf_path}, week1 = #{week1}, week2 = #{week2}, week3 = #{week3}, week4 = #{week4}, week5 = #{week5}, week6 = #{week6}, week7 = #{week7}, week8 = #{week8}, week9 = #{week9}, week10 = #{week10}, week11 = #{week11}, week12 = #{week12}, week13 = #{week13}, week14 = #{week14}, week15 = #{week15} WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId};
UPDATE pu_syllabus SET pdf_path = #{pdfPath}, status = 'COMPLETE' WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId};
